name: ring mark closes into an eyelid then opens as a glowing eye, word by word
looks: A short declarative sentence lands one or two words per hard cut over a stark flip between black and white fields. In step with it, the ring mark from the opening thins into a closed eyelid line, then arcs open into a wide eye whose iris is built from that same ring of pebble shapes, glowing from within.
build: The ring's points interpolate to a thin horizontal eyelid shape, then the eyelid arcs open while the ring reappears inside the opening as the iris, lit from within (same resample-and-lerp morph approach as a shape morph). Each word is its own hard-cut layer on the beat, alternating light and dark fields with a strong chromatic-aberration glitch on every cut.
sound: A dry tick on each word cut, a soft whoosh as the eye opens, and a rising hum under the glow.
prompt: Say a short, punchy claim one or two words per hard cut, flipping the field between a light and a dark ground each time, while the film's own mark morphs from a closed line into an eye whose iris is built from that same mark, so the sentence lands right as the mark reveals it is also an eye.
